First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $x,$ treating $y$ and $z$ as constants:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{z}{\int }_{0}^{y+z}2xyz\,dx\,dy\,dz & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{z}[{\int }_{0}^{y+z}2xyz\,dx]dy\,dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{z}[{x}^{2}yz]_{x=0}^{x=y+z}\,dy\,dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{z}(y+z)^{2}yz\,dy\,dz\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $y,$ treating $z$ as a constant:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{z}(y+z)^{2}yz\,dy\,dz & ={\int }_{0}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{z}{y}^{3}z+2{y}^{2}{z}^{2}+y{z}^{3}\,dy]dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{[\frac{1}{4}{y}^{4}z+\frac{2}{3}{y}^{3}{z}^{2}+\frac{1}{2}{y}^{2}{z}^{3}]}_{y=0}^{y=z}\,dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{1}{4}{z}^{5}+\frac{2}{3}{z}^{5}+\frac{1}{2}{z}^{5}\,dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{17}{12}{z}^{5}\,dz\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $z:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{17}{12}{z}^{5}\,dz & ={[\frac{17}{72}{z}^{6}]}_{0}^{2} \\  & =\frac{17}{72}\cdot 64 \\  & =\frac{136}{9}\end{aligned}
$$
